answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake in a shared vault before it can transact. Like water filtering through karst limestone, each transaction leaves a traceable path, and an onyx seal is stamped on identities whose stake has aged without misbehavior. Honest agents then gather in one haven of trusted counterparts, because a single well-aged identity earns more than dozens of fresh, stake-poor clones — so an attacker must pay the full stake and the waiting cost for every fake identity they spin up.
